criteria.text: Returning to my paused product keeps the selected parts, journey, saved data and remaining call allowance.
If setup fails, the instructions name my real source files and keep the product options in the retry command.
A request with an unknown result is read again using its existing identity and is never automatically sent twice.

cases.given: Paused product session with selected phone/server/barista, J1, retained world and 7 calls remaining.
cases.required_observation: Owner-tool request reopens same session and selection; no new setup or allowance reset.

cases.given: Lint rejects an effective generated app map for an authored phone map setting.
cases.required_observation: Hint names authored phone map and includes --product, selected --parts and --journey J1; never asks to edit virtual map.

cases.given: Product request accepted but terminal receipt unavailable.
cases.required_observation: Read exact original request/session; no second POST or automatic replacement.
